analysis_steps.goal: Measure ALMA continuum fluxes at Herschel positions

findings_qualitative.value: Elevated SFRs at high z and above the MS are due to both increased gas contents and increased star formation efficiency.

evidence.quote: the elevated rates of SF activity at both high redshift and above the MS are due to both increased gas contents and increased efficiencies for converting the gas to stars.

findings_qualitative.value: Gas fractions >50% at z>2, decreasing with stellar mass

evidence.loc: 7.1 Gas Depletion Timescales and Gas Mass Fraction
evidence.quote: The gas mass fractions shown in Figure 10-Right are very high ( >50%) at z >2 for SF galaxies, systematically decreasing at later epochs.

claims.hypothesis: Is elevated SF at high z and above the MS driven by more gas or higher efficiency?
claims.experiment: Power-law MCMC fits of M_ISM and SFR/M_ISM versus z, M*, sSFR/sSFR_MS for 575 galaxies
claims.finding: Both increased ISM mass and increased SF efficiency contribute

evidence.quote: thus the increased activities at early epochs are driven by both increased ISM masses and SF efficiency.

claims.hypothesis: What gas accretion rates are required to maintain MS evolution?
claims.experiment: MS continuity principle with M_ISM relation
claims.result: Net accretion >100 Msun/yr at z>2.5; Macc ∝ (1+z)^3.60
claims.finding: Galaxy evolution at early epochs is driven by accretion

evidence.quote: we estimate the accretion rates of gas required to maintain continuity of the MS evolution ( > 100 M ⊙ yr [−] [1] at z > 2.5).

why_this_method.value: RJ dust continuum is optically thin, linear in mass-weighted T and avoids CO excitation uncertainty; needs far fewer observations than CO

evidence.loc: 3.4 Complete Sample of ALMA-detected IR-bright Galaxies
evidence.quote: our analysis involving the RJ dust continuum avoids the issue of variable excitation which causes uncertainty when using different CO transitions across galaxy samples.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Using SED-fit variable T_D was rejected as it gives luminosity-weighted rather than mass-weighted temperature

evidence.quote: we believe that using a T D derived from the SED fits yields a luminosityweighted T D , not the physically correct mass-weighted T D .

limitations_admitted.value: Sample biased to IR-bright, massive galaxies; not representative of the high-z SF population

evidence.quote: the sample is not representative of the high redshift SF galaxy population.

limitations_admitted.value: Calibration gives ~factor 2 accuracy; fit uncertainties exclude calibration uncertainties

evidence.quote: they do not account for possible calibration uncertainties such as the conversion from L IR to SFR.
